dashboard.newsSummary: This important development organized by our university holds great significance for both academic and local communities.
dashboard.newsBody:
During the visit, academic cooperation between the two universities, joint projects, and strategic studies focused on regional development were discussed. Our Rector expressed gratitude to the visiting delegation for their kind visit and stated that they would continue to work in solidarity to improve the quality of education in our region.

During the meeting, ideas were exchanged on topics such as the development of university campuses, the expansion of student exchange programs, and sharing of technological infrastructure. The visit concluded with a mutual gift exchange and a commemorative photograph.
dashboard.announcementSummary: This announcement published by Kırklareli University Rectorate applies to all relevant units and students.
dashboard.announcementBody:
All items specified in the announcement must be implemented according to the relevant calendar. For detailed information, you may contact the relevant department secretariat.

It is of great importance that our students follow their academic processes without interruption and adhere to the specified dates.
dashboard.eventSummary: This event, organized in line with Kırklareli University's vision, is planned to encourage academic sharing and enhance social interaction.
dashboard.eventBody:
Throughout the event, participants will be offered presentations, workshops, and networking opportunities on various topics. Open to all students and staff.

Participation is free, but spots are limited. Please contact the relevant club or unit to register.
